## PM queue

One question, from criterion 2b (goes to `scope-scenario`; Path: new territory if it reaches the PM): F067's rulings make following a private Page the same act as joining it (membership and read access at once), while F065 criterion 2 says a follow never grants membership. Which holds: A) a private Page cannot be followed, only requested; B) amend criterion 2 to exclude private Pages; C) keep the follow as is and say so.
